title: 递归自进化智能体通过留出选择实现安全提升
summary: 提出RSEA（递归自进化智能体），通过维护三层自然语言状态（策略、技能、剧本）并利用留出验证门控机制，确保每次进化不退化。在ALFWorld、GAIA、τ-bench和WebShop四个基准测试中，RSEA在ALFWorld上达到69.3%（单次）和79.4%（重试），且不会显著低于基础智能体，解决了无门控上下文进化高方差和不安全的问题。
summary_en: Introduces RSEA (Recursive Self-Evolving Agent) with a three-layer natural-language state (strategy, skills, playbook) and a held-out validation gate to ensure monotone-safe evolution. Across four benchmarks, RSEA achieves 69.3% (single-pass) and 79.4% (with retry) on ALFWorld, never significantly underperforming the base agent, addressing high-variance and unsafe context evolution.
